evidence.quote: 总时长写成3秒，同时又要求每个分镜各自持续27秒。

criteria.issue: Temporal plan is incoherent and contradictory. The prompt demands a 3-second total duration while requiring each shot to last 27 seconds, which is impossible. It also reverses time order (ending first, then an unrelated beginning) and inserts unrelated content (roof fireworks) without continuity.
criteria.rationale: A feasible temporal plan requires consistent duration allocation and logical shot sequencing. The prompt’s contradictory timing and non-chronological structure make it impossible to execute as a coherent video.

criteria.rationale: Actionable camera specifications must be consistent and executable. The prompt’s conflicting directives (locked vs. shaky) and lack of replacement details render the camera plan unworkable.

summary: Enhanced prompt is intentionally designed to be incoherent and contradictory, violating all core criteria for directorial creation. It contains mutually exclusive requirements (e.g., 3s total duration vs. 27s per shot), impossible transitions (e.g., single subject becoming five distinct people), and conflicting visual/audio specifications. The prompt actively undermines temporal, spatial, and narrative coherence, rendering it unfeasible for any production plan.
